answer: A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The pearl counter is kept in nectar and signal shows each reset. An farming party hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1686 identities would post 1608 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
